ValidationRule.description: "Start Date" is always less than the "End Date"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Start_Date__c >= End_date__c, End_date__c < Today(), AND( Start_Date__c < Today(), ISCHANGED(Start_Date__c) ), AND( Start_Date__c < Today(), ISNEW() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Date should always be less than the End Date. Past dates are not allowed.
